title: Cloud Platform Engineer
job_description:
Job Description: Platform & Cloud Migration Engineer (Contractor) GC/citizens only

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Platform & Cloud Migration Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will deliver platform engineering, automation, cloud migration, and operational enablement services across our AWS and hybrid environments.

Work will be maintained in a Product Owner-prioritized backlog and authorized through work packages, sprint plans, tickets, and written task assignments.

Key ResponsibilitiesInfrastructure as Code & Automation

Develop, enhance, test, and document Terraform modules, pipelines, governance controls, and run automation.
Enable self-service AWS infrastructure provisioning through Terraform integrated with ServiceNow.

Cloud Architecture, EKS & Workload Migration

Design, build, configure, and support Amazon EKS clusters and drive containerized application migrations to EKS.
Assess, plan, execute, validate, and document the migration of virtual machines and workloads from VMware to Amazon EC2.
Support cloud environment buildouts, platform integrations, application dependency mapping, and overall data center exit initiatives.

Data, AI & Cloud Storage Services

Support AWS AI platforms, including Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker.
Manage and integrate AWS storage and data platforms, including EBS, EFS, S3, and Amazon Redshift.

Architecture & Solution Design

Support architecture discovery, solution design, and Technical Architecture (TA) review processes.
Prepare and maintain current-state and target-state diagrams, design decisions, dependency views, security, resiliency, and capacity considerations.
Create required architecture review artifacts, address review feedback, and secure appropriate architecture approvals prior to implementation.

Security, Compliance & Vulnerability Management

Assess, prioritize, remediate, test, and document security vulnerabilities across platform, infrastructure-as-code, container, OS, middleware, and migration components in accordance with cybersecurity standards and timelines.
Directly triage and remediate defects, risks, and technical blockers related to authorized platform engineering and migration tasks.

Migration Execution & Operational Readiness

Plan and support migration executions, including readiness assessments, change management records, cutover/rollback planning, command-center support, hypercare, post-migration validation, and issue stabilization.
Prepare operational handoffs: establish monitoring, alerting, and logging; validate backup and recovery; update service asset inventories/CMDB; complete runbooks; and conduct support-team training for formal operational acceptance.
Author migration patterns, operating procedures, technical documentation, and knowledge-transfer materials.

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

Cloud Platform: Advanced hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS).
Infrastructure as Code: Deep experience writing, testing, and maintaining Terraform modules and automation pipelines.
Containers & Orchestration: Proven experience designing, building, and supporting Amazon EKS clusters and containerized applications.
Migration Expertise: Demonstrated success migrating VMware virtualized environments to Amazon EC2 and refactoring applications for AWS.
Storage & Data Services: Hands-on experience with AWS storage (EBS, EFS, S3) and data warehouses/analytics platforms (Amazon Redshift).
AI Platform Familiarity: Practical experience supporting or integrating with AWS AI services (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker).
Service Management & ITSM: Experience integrating IaC workflows with ServiceNow for automated provisioning and change control.
Architecture & Frameworks: Ability to create architectural artifacts, sequence diagrams, and target-state designs to pass formal Technical Architecture reviews.
Security & Vulnerability Remediation: Proficiency in vulnerability scanning analysis, patch management, and securing IaC and containerized environments.

Soft Skills & Working Style

Agile Delivery: Comfortable working within an SBP/Product Owner-driven agile framework (sprints, backlog prioritization, ticketing).
Documentation & Enablement: Strong technical writing skills for creating runbooks, cutover plans, and knowledge-transfer materials.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to partner with architecture, security, and operational teams to drive clean handoffs and production readiness.

Job Types: Contract, Full-time

Pay: $50.00 - $60.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
